g.text: Apache Kafka Complete Flow — WeatherStation Repository
Every Kafka Topic (4), Producer (3), Kafka Streams App (1), Consumer Group (1), and Schema Registry (:8081)
Topic with no consumer in repo
Producers: [P1] StationIdAllocator (byte[]) • [P2] Telemetry Producer (Avro) • [P3] DLQ Producer (byte[]) | Readers: WarningApp (Streams) • ConsumerLoop (Group)
if >= 0 -> skip Kafka & use ID immediately
• Sets station_id in BOTH Kafka record key
• Sends raw payload bytes + dlq-error header
Registers, versions, and serves the Avro StatusMessage schema to Avro serializers/deserializers (Producer #2, WarningApp, BaseStationConsumer).
Persists registered schemas back inside Apache Kafka via SCHEMA_REGISTRY_KAFKASTORE_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS=kafka:9092 (_schemas topic). Bypassed by Producer #1 & Producer #3 (byte[]).
battery_status (string), status_timestamp (long), weather (["null", WeatherReading {humidity, temperature, wind_speed}])
